title: Office Yoga and Time Out for Companies in Coburg | Yoga Momente
description: Office yoga, a healthy lunch break and mindfulness for companies in Coburg: live and online, planned individually by Susanne Müller.

sections.title: A break from office life
sections.lead: Yoga and mindfulness for your team: live at the office or online, as a healthy lunch break or at a company event.

sections.title: Give your employees a break from everyday working life.
paragraphs: Perhaps a healthy shared lunch break or a session at one of your company events is the right thing for your employees or business partners?
I am happy to plan the session that suits you together with you and send you an offer.

items.title: Movement
items.text: Gentle exercises that work well in the office and relieve the back.

items.title: Relaxation
items.text: Room to switch off, in the middle of the working day.

items.title: Meditation
items.text: Short meditations that clear the mind.

items.title: Mindfulness
items.text: Mindfulness exercises for more calm and focus in everyday life.

items.title: Inquiry
items.text: You call or write me an email.

items.title: Planning together
items.text: We clarify whether live or online, how long and with what focus.

items.title: Your offer
items.text: You receive an offer for the right session.

sections.title: I look forward to your call or your inquiry by email.
